from scipy import ndimage
lab,n=ndimage.label(g!=0,structure=np.ones((3,3)))
best=None
for i in range(1,n+1):
    ys,xs=np.where(lab==i)
    n9=(g[ys,xs]==9).sum()
    if best is None or n9<best[0]: best=(n9,i)
print(best)
out=g.copy()
i=best[1]
ys,xs=np.where(lab==i)
out[ys,xs]=0
print('\n'.join(' '.join(map(str,row)) for row in out))
